Q&A

The question everyone asks first.

What exactly is a harness?

A harness is the execution layer around a model: instructions, model policy, tools and MCP, skills, runtime and sandbox, permissions and guardrails, plus the output contract. It is what lets a model do work and return artifacts instead of only replying with text.

Why not just use Codex or Claude directly?

You should use them to build your app. HarnessRouter solves a different problem: it brings the capabilities of Codex and Claude Code into your product. Your users get finished work without opening a terminal or leaving your product. With HarnessRouter, your app can run AI agents that create real artifacts for your users: videos, games, codebases, docs, and more, through one API.

How much does it cost?

Start with a 7-day trial. After that, choose a monthly platform plan: Developer, Production, or Scale. Plans include credits for production agent work; additional usage runs from top-up balance with budgets and hard caps.

Do I need to understand agents to use this?

No. Drop our AGENTS.md into Cursor or Claude Code, describe your feature, and your coding agent wires everything: the endpoint, the config, the UI. The demos above were built exactly this way.

Am I locked into one harness?

The opposite. That is the point. Your config names the harness: claude-code today, codex tomorrow, or back again, swapped anytime with one line. Your integration code and output schema never change. When a better harness ships next quarter, your product gets better with a config change.

What exactly comes back to my app?

Structured, renderable results: code changes as reviewable diffs, generated files and documents, images, and confirmations of real tool actions like GitHub, Slack, Notion, or internal APIs. Your UI decides how to show them and when the user accepts.

Q&A

每个人首先问的问题。

What exactly is a harness?

线束是模型周围的执行层：指令、模型策略、工具和 MCP、技能、运行时和沙箱、权限和护栏，以及输出契约。 它让模型能够工作并返回工件，而不是仅用文本进行回复。

Why not just use Codex or Claude directly?

您应该使用它们来构建您的应用程序。 HarnessRouter 解决了另一个问题：它将 Codex 和 Claude Code 的功能引入您的产品中。 您的用户无需打开终端或离开您的产品即可完成工作。 借助 HarnessRouter，您的应用程序可以运行 AI 代理，通过一个 API 为您的用户创建真实的工件：视频、游戏、代码库、文档等。

How much does it cost?

从 7 天试用开始。 之后，选择每月平台计划：开发人员、生产或规模。 计划包括制作代理工作的学分；额外的使用量来自预算和硬上限的充值余额。

Do I need to understand agents to use this?

不。将我们的 AGENTS.md 放入 Cursor 或 Claude Code 中，描述您的功能，然后您的编码代理会连接所有内容：端点、配置、UI。 上面的演示正是按照这种方式构建的。

Am I locked into one harness?

相反。 这就是重点。 您的配置将线束命名为：今天的 claude-code，明天的 codex，或者再次返回，随时用一行进行交换。 您的集成代码和输出架构永远不会改变。 当下个季度推出更好的线束时，您的产品会通过配置更改而变得更好。

What exactly comes back to my app?

结构化、可渲染的结果：代码更改为可审查的差异、生成的文件和文档、图像以及 GitHub、Slack、Notion 或内部 API 等真实工具操作的确认。 您的 UI 决定如何显示它们以及用户何时接受。
